decisive_items: Histology showed a malignant spindle cell neoplasm
positive immunostaining for α-smooth muscle actin, vimentin, and desmin
response.rationale: Histology and IHC are definitive for sarcoma, overriding the clinical diagnosis of meningioma.

rejected.why: Clinical diagnosis of meningioma is contradicted by malignant spindle cell histology and IHC.
No supporting evidence; metastasis was only in the differential diagnosis.
Negative EBV staining and histology do not support primary lymphoma.
